title: Result of contact.put
description: Request args: {"key": 64 hex digits, "name": 1 to 31 bytes, "type": chat, repeater, room or sensor, "lat_e6" and "lon_e6": both or neither}. Adds the contact or updates the named fields of a stored one, as the native CMD_ADD_UPDATE_CONTACT frame does: a new contact needs name and type, and has no flags and no known path; an update keeps the flags (grants and protection) and the path. A put cannot grant telemetry or the remote CLI. A full table behaves as for the app (the oldest unprotected contact is overwritten when the overwrite setting is on) or is failed with error table-full; the contact is saved by the native lazy write. A repeat is the same state. A shared secret and the path bytes are never in a result. Companion only.

type.description: Never none: type 0 is the anonymous slot's and is not a stored contact.

fav.description: The native favourite flag: the contact is protected from the oldest-first eviction.

last_advert.description: Their clock at their last advert.

hops.description: Hops of the known path; -1: none, the contact is reached by flood.

created.description: True when the key was not stored before.

changed.description: False when the contact already held these values: nothing is written then, and lastmod is not touched.
